description: This file defines the EmployeeTerminationService class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It provides methods for accessing termination-related data, such as retrieving termination reasons from the DAO and normalizing them. It employs traits and interacts with specific models and data access objects related to employee terminations.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationService
classes.description: Service class for handling employee termination data, including retrieving and normalizing termination reasons.

methods.name: getEmployeeTerminationDao
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeTerminationDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonsArray
methods.description: Fetches the list of termination reasons from DAO and normalizes the array for external use.
